dataset.name: Momentum: latest
dataset.caption: Kenneth French's daily momentum factor (long last year's winners, short last year's losers). Window: the 750 trading days ending at the latest date in the source file (2023-09-05 to 2026-08-31); the first 250 (to 2024-08-30) are the healthy warm-up. Why this window: the latest 750 trading days in the source file, so no hindsight went into choosing it. Same rule for every real dataset. Thresholds were tuned on strategies simulated from the warm-up fit, never on these returns. Source: Kenneth R. French Data Library.
